Zero Caps Does Not Mean an Empty Story――熊坂光希が日本代表へ戻るまで

Koki Kumasaka has been selected for Japan again, yet his senior international record still says zero caps. His first call-up in June 2025 ended with a right ACL tear during national-team training. 349 days later he returned to competition, and 117 days after that he was called back. 柏U-12の2度の落選、U-18のBチーム、東京国際大での成長まで遡ると、このzero is not empty. It is accumulated time waiting for the first one.
